基于 melonDS 核心的高性能 Android 端 WatermelonDS 分支模拟器，支持 Vulkan 3D、RetroArch 着色器与 RetroAchievements。
STORM DS, melonDS, WatermelonDS, 作者与开源许可

STORM DS is an advanced fork of WatermelonDS (developed by SapphireRhodonite 与贡献者), which is an Android port of the melonDS core (StapleButter, Nadia, RSDuck, genericretrogeek, Arisotura 与团队). Includes extensive Slot-1 DSiWare direct boot fixes, NAND/Firmware integrity protection, RetroAchievements offline play 和 sync, external dual display on TV/monitors via USB-C/HDMI, fast ROM scanner, HUD positioning, and custom themes.
